payload.title: persona self-constancy
payload.body: Future scope, not planned: a persona is meant as an individual with self-constancy (mind, body and soul in the operator's words), which needs machinery beyond its cell: its own memory, continuity across sessions, presence outside a session. The oikos project (~/workspaces/oikos, product Bozwell; packages agent-identity, memory, agent-archetypes) is where the first experiments live; there an agent is a person with its own name, never the product's. Whether that machinery belongs in cratylus is undecided.
